verdict.rationale: Viam is a robotics platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The 'use Viam from an agent' docs describe agents operating machines through a shell (the CLI) or an SDK. Those are developer building blocks and an adjacent capability, so they earn no credit toward an official MCP server.
